entries.name: Rabbit (realistic)
entries.style: mid-poly, realistic proportions (CDmir 2015); photo texture flattened to flat colours; height 0.3 m to the ear tips at rest (crouched on all fours; 0.32 m sitting, 0.4 m standing up in Guarding), a real domestic rabbit's size

source.author: CDmir (Čestmír Dammer)
source.note: Wave-1 row 16 named the rabbit from Quaternius's Animated Animals on poly.pizza, which sits behind a Cloudflare challenge (and Quaternius's Google Drive is quota-blocked); no reachable Quaternius pack has a rabbit. This is the realistic CC0 rabbit CDmir made for Kelgar (the same author and series as the library's chicken); the Kenney Cube Pets bunny (entry 'rabbit') is the chibi alternative. Its .blend uses legacy Blender Internal materials with three packed images; ingest.legacyImage picks the colour map 'rabbot-skinn' (the others are the fur-card texture and a normal map). The fur-card shell mesh 'Fur' and the ground 'Plane' are dropped. The photo texture is flattened to 24 clusters: every fur cluster goes to one white coat (a white moon rabbit), and the near-black cluster (#090605), which holds the eyes and the whisker strands, goes to 'eye', drawn flat black without an ink hull, so the whiskers read as fine lines instead of inked sticks. Clips: Sitting.000 (a sit with slow head turns) is idle and sit; Running is a bounding run, Jump a single hop, Dying.000 a slump to the ground; Guarding (standing up on the hind legs) and the duplicates keep their source names. Running, Jump, Guarding and the Dying clips clamp to the ground (the feet dipped up to 3 cm at landings and as the body slumps).
